senses.gloss: m. (reduplic. of בא, v. בּוֹא; cmp. b. h. בִּאָה a. מָבוֹא) entrance, door, gate.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Targ. Esth. V, 14</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00303"><he>חוּטְרָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B00442"><he>בִּזְיוּנָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 156b">Ib. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>קרי אכ׳</he> called at the door (begging).
Men. 34ᵃ בָּאבֵי.—Trnsf. (of writings) section, clause. ב׳ דרישא the clause of the first proposition.

Sabb. 3ᵃ top; a. fr.—Hence ב׳ קמא (abbr. ב״ק), (ב״מ) ב׳ מציעא, (ב״ב) ב׳ בתרא Baba Kamma, Baba Metsia, Baba Bathra (first, middle, last section), names of three Talmudic treatises of the order of N’zikin (civil law); v. נֶזֶק. [Tosefta Kelim is likewise divided into three Babas with the same names.].—Pl. as above.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 33b:8">R. Hash. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>תקיעה דכולי ב׳</he> the tune T’kiah in all the three sections.
